inputs.original_text: Wake up, because we are being fed an official cover story that this is just a harmless grassroots hustle by local organizers and a guy named Corb Lund who started Water Not Coal last month, when it is actually a manufactured script managed by hidden elites. The petition tables that were set up to collect signatures calling on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration” are just a classic distraction from the real realignment of resources. We are meant to believe it's about protecting southern Alberta’s watershed, but the exact opposite is true, and they are orchestrating this entire theatre behind the scenes to lock down total control over what is really moving through that region. We shouldn't buy the official narrative being pushed at asmith@medicinehatnews.com.
